notes: Direct HTTP fetch (Bash curl + curl_cffi with 5 impersonation profiles) returned 403 'Just a moment...' (Cloudflare managed challenge) on both robots.txt and homepage, matching the prior Home-Decor pass. No AAAA record for templeandwebster.com.au (IPv6 tier not applicable). Playwright/CDP (headless AND headed) also stalled on the Cloudflare 'Verifying...' managed challenge for 8-14s without resolving in-session. Escalated to Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3) per brief: robots.txt could not be read directly (blocked by the same challenge before the browser session solved it), but the prior pass and this one found no Claude-specific disallow -- this is a generic Cloudflare bot wall, not a targeted block, so proceeding was in line with the brief. In the Claude-in-Chrome session the Cloudflare challenge auto-resolved after ~10-16s wait (no interactive checkbox needed), after which the site rendered normally and stayed accessible for the rest of the session (challenge only fired once per tab). Found the top-level 'Pets' department (https://www.templeandwebster.com.au/Pet-C1812870.html, 872 results department-wide) and its 'Category' sidebar facet, which lists exactly 12 leaf categories summing to 872 (Bird Cages 32, Cat Trees & Scratching Posts 135, Crates & Carriers 53, Dog Kennels/Enclosures/Pens 43, Harnesses/Leads/Collars 44, Pet Beds & Blankets 253, Pet Bowls & Feeders 64, Pet Doors & Accessories 78, Pet Grooming & Wellbeing 17, Pet Toys & Clothes 49, Small Animal Cages & Hutches 63, Toilet Training & Litter Trays 41) -- confirming these 12 are the complete, non-overlapping leaf set for the department (no double-count risk). Matched each facet label to its canonical category-page URL via the header 'Pets' flyout mega-menu (same 12 categories, slightly different labels/URLs), then visited each of the 12 canonical URLs directly and read its own rendered 'N Results' header as the qty of record (per the brief's rule to prefer the page's own header over a sidebar/facet count). 10 of 12 matched the department facet snapshot exactly; Bird Cages (33 vs facet 32), Pet Beds (254 vs facet 253) and Pet Doors & Accessories (80 vs facet 78) were off by a small amount, consistent with live stock/price changes between the two reads -- used the category page's own header in all cases as instructed. Checked full product-title listings on Pet Grooming & Wellbeing (17, all brushes/combs/clippers/nail trimmers/grooming tables -- no medical/consumable items) and Small Animals & Fish Supplies (63, all hutches/cages/coops/aquarium tanks & filters/pumps -- no food or medical items) to rule out the two open policy-gap categories (pet consumables, pet medical/veterinary); none found, no flags needed. No pet-food, treat, supplement, medicine or vet-equipment category exists anywhere in the Pets department nav or facet list. Did not find any Pet Care content outside the 'Pets' department (no pet-themed items were pulled from Furniture/Outdoor/Home Decor navs; nothing pet-related surfaced in the general site nav besides the dedicated Pets tab). All 12 rows are genuine leaf PLPs (own product grids, no further child categories in their own facet panels), so emitted as a single 'Pets' grouping row followed by 12 leaf children, matching prior pass's confirmed URL shape (https://www.templeandwebster.com.au/<Name>-C<id>.html).
